meta.title: Billing Software | POS, Inventory, Accounts & WhatsApp | Digithack
meta.description: Digithack Billing Software helps businesses manage billing, stock, staff, accounts, expenses and customer communication in one smart cloud-based platform.

hero.headline: Digithack Smart Billing Software
hero.subLine: Powerful yet simple billing software to manage sales, inventory, staff and accounts with real-time reports and WhatsApp integration.

blocks.title: Complete Business Billing System
blocks.content: Our billing software is built for retail stores, supermarkets, restaurants and service businesses. It simplifies invoicing, tracks stock, manages staff and provides clear financial reports so you can focus on growing your business.

items.title: Fast Billing
items.description: Create professional invoices in seconds with barcode scanning, quick search and multiple payment options like cash, UPI and card.

items.title: Multi-Device Billing
items.description: Use the billing system on desktop, laptop or tablet with cloud sync. Perfect for counters, mobile billing and multi-location stores.

items.title: Real-Time Inventory
items.description: Inventory updates automatically after each sale or purchase so you always know your exact stock levels.

items.title: Smart Alerts
items.description: Get low stock alerts, manage suppliers and maintain proper stock flow to avoid shortages or overstocking.

items.title: User Roles & Permissions
items.description: Create staff accounts with role-based access to control billing, reports and sensitive data securely.

items.title: Sales Tracking
items.description: Track staff performance, monitor sales and generate reports to improve productivity.

items.title: Income & GST Reports
items.description: Generate accurate sales, purchase and GST reports instantly. Stay compliant and ready for tax filing.

items.title: Profit Insights
items.description: View profit, revenue and business performance through easy dashboards and downloadable reports.

items.title: Daily Expense Tracking
items.description: Record and manage all business expenses in one place to maintain better financial control.

items.title: Expense Reports
items.description: View categorized expense reports by day, month or year for smarter budgeting decisions.

items.title: Send Bills Instantly
items.description: Share digital invoices and receipts directly with customers on WhatsApp after every purchase.

items.title: Reminders & Promotions
items.description: Send payment reminders, offers and updates to customers to improve engagement and repeat sales.

blocks.content: We also provide setup, training and customization based on your business needs. Our goal is to simplify your billing process and help your business run faster, smarter and more efficiently.
